tex_content.html:
Definition

For $a\in \mathbb {R}^n$, a derivation at $a$ is an $\mathbb {R}$-linear map $w:C^\infty (\mathbb {R}^n)\to \mathbb {R}$ satisfying \[ w(fg)=f(a)w(g)+g(a)w(f). \tag {3.3} \] The vector space of such derivations is denoted $T_a\mathbb {R}^n$, with pointwise operations \[ (w_1+w_2)(f)=w_1(f)+w_2(f),qquad (cw)(f)=c\, w(f). \]
